prerequisites: Requirements to access the Master's studies in Telecommunication Engineering.
For company internships via educational agreement, the student must meet the conditions cited in article 4 of the External Internship Regulations of the University of Oviedo.
syllabus_topics: Realization of internships in companies in the sector, technological or research centers, or research groups of the University of Oviedo.

assessment_methods.method: Assessment by the tutor of the host entity

assessment_rules: Assessment will be carried out by evaluating the reports submitted by the student, the evaluation by the tutor of the entity where the internships are carried out, and the monitoring by the academic tutor. With all this, the academic tutor will evaluate the developed internships by completing the corresponding final assessment report.
bibliography: Specific to each agreement or placement.
institution: Universidad de Oviedo - Máster Universitario en Ingeniería de Telecomunicación (Telecomunicación, Gijón)
degree: Máster Universitario en Ingeniería de Telecomunicación
